body:
OUTSIDE-ADVISOR TRACEABILITY — architectural idea versus project status.

ADOPTED IN THE LANDED PLAN
- One narrative ontology for text and movies; movie-specific evidence below it: sections 2 and 13 D1.
- Exact edition-aware clocks, native PTS/DTS, scanner/recall/story-world separation, partial mappings: section 3 and D2.
- Timed text as an evidence lattice, never subtitle ground truth: section 4 and D3.
- Voice, face, appearance continuity, and character as non-convertible identities: section 5 and D4.
- Raw evidence -> measurements -> proposals/findings -> deterministic resolver: section 6 and D5.
- Scala owns contracts, joins, resolution, receipts; versioned workers own inference: section 7 and D6.
- Coarse-to-fine scheduling with SourceFrozen, DiagnosticExpansion, and CrossFittedExpansion: section 8 and D7.
- Claim-family-specific adversarial courts and modality ablations: section 10 and D9.
- Renderer-neutral StoryAtlas packets with distinct playback, epistemic, narrative, recall, and screen coordinates: section 11 and D10.

DESIGNED BUT NOT YET IMPLEMENTED
- SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, EvidenceSupport, NarrativeSourceAtlas, and typed boundary layers: C1 after P1 plus B0.
- Current compiler/model/alignment/feature/claim/codec migration: D1.
- Timed-language workers and lattice construction: G1.
- Face/voice/active-speaker/character and perceptual proposal tracks: G2.
- Expanded source construction, hierarchy, causality, and accepted cross-modal events: G3.
- Transcript-only, visual-only, audio-only, late-fusion, and one-shot comparisons: G4.
- Movie and recall visualization consumption: V1/V2 after the scientific vertical.

CANDIDATES, NOT DECISIONS
Whisper/Parakeet/MFA, pyannote/Sortformer, active-speaker models, TransNet, face/object tracking, DINO/V-JEPA/InternVideo, CLAP/OpenBEATs/PE-AV, separation, and Qwen/omni models. Each needs its own exact artifact, rights, preprocessing, runtime, calibration, coverage, and authority court. The first lawful court deliberately uses no learned checkpoint.

ONE INTENTIONAL DEPARTURE FROM THE ADVISOR
The advisor's proposed MovieModel shape is conceptually right but too direct as an implementation type. The accepted plan does not use one generic Observation supertype or let structurally checked local charts become facts. It separates byte/source authority, measurement sidecars, semantic proposals, critic findings, joined outcomes, and accepted claims. That stricter authority gradient is the project's main contribution beyond a conventional multimodal pipeline.

This traceability is descriptive of landed plan b12f79c plus pending D2 V8; it grants no implementation or acquisition authority.
